BiblicalUsage: 1) to despise, hold in contempt, disdain; 1a) (Qal) to despise, regard with contempt; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be despised; 1b2) to be despicable; 1b3) to be vile, worthless; 1c) (Hiphil) to cause to despise
